title: Mandate 83 records that cloud agents close tasks through main
goal: Vision: V-8. The workflow tool now lets a host that may not write the queue's refs close a task: the close receipt is kept on main, and publishing a finished task releases its claim (commercial T-CLAUDECLOUDCLOSE-1). Make docs/ceo-mandate-83.md say so and take the gap out of its not-enforced list.
limitations: Wording only in this repository; the tool change is in intellibitz/susi-commercial-apps. This task was claimed, renewed by publishing, closed and released through main from a cloud session, by the tool.
Main is unqualified development, not a release.
